item.title: [−1] October CPI inflation expected near 6%, up from 5.54% in September, on food prices
item.description:
Edible oil, tomatoes and pulses show entrenched rises; data due 12 November ahead of the December RBI meeting. Escalating food inflation.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Food cost pressure

Why it matters: Higher inflation keeps pressure on the RBI to stay tight, limiting relief for bonds and rate-sensitive sectors despite cheaper oil.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −2, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India offers to help restore Black Sea grain exports as the PM and Ukraine's president discuss peace
item.description:
Ukraine says India is ready to mediate food corridors; Black Sea cargo traffic is down 37%. Builds on earlier corridor proposals.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Edible oil relief

Why it matters: Restored Black Sea grain and edible oil flows would ease world food prices and India's food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
